title: Alwida alwida ae behen alwida
body:
Alwida alwida ae behen alwida
alwida alwida ae behen alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
shahe tashna dahan, bewatan bekafan
waqt e rukhsat ye kehte the meri behen
<<MINI>>
alwida alwida ae behen alwida..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Hum to ran ko chale, alwida alwida
khoo me rote hue, alwida alwida
kya kare jeeke ab, alwida alwida
lut chuka hai chaman, alwida alwida
<<MINI>>
alwida alwida ae behen alwida..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Bhai maara gaya, alwida alwida
har sahara gaya, alwida alwida
tukde tukde hua, alwida alwida
haaye ibn e hasan, alwida alwida
<<MINI>>
alwida alwida ae behen alwida..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Haaye akbar jawaa, alwida alwida
rahate qalb o jaan, alwida alwida
kha chuka hai sina, alwida alwida
khu me tarr hai badan, alwida alwida
<<MINI>>
alwida alwida ae behen alwida..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Jhoola veeran hai, alwida alwida
lab pe ab jaan hai, alwida alwida
laashe asghar hai aur, alwida alwida
jal raha hai ye ban, alwida alwida
<<MINI>>
alwida alwida ae behen alwida..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ab sakina meri, alwida alwida
kis tarah soegi, alwida alwida
khaegi ghudkiya, alwida alwida aur bandhegi rasan, alwida alwida
<<MINI>>
alwida alwida ae behen alwida..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Jab chinegi rida, alwida alwida
zainab e ghum zada, alwida alwida
sabr karna bohot, alwida alwida
sehna ranj o mahan, alwida alwida
<<MINI>>
alwida alwida ae behen alwida..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Ghash me hai laadla, alwida alwida
yani zainul eba, alwida alwida
ab hawale tere, alwida alwida
hai mera gul badan, alwida alwida
<<MINI>>
alwida alwida ae behen alwida..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Shaam jana hai ab, alwida alwida
hai bada ye ghazab, alwida alwida
berida hogi tu, alwida alwida
roenge panjetan, alwida alwida
<<MINI>>
alwida alwida ae behen alwida..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Jake bazaar me, alwida alwida aur darbaar me, alwida alwida
mere paigham ko, alwida alwida
bhoona na behen, alwida alwida
<<MINI>>
alwida alwida ae behen alwida..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Meesam e ghum zada, alwida alwida
nauha rehan ka, alwida alwida
maine padh to diya, alwida alwida
gunja sheh ka sukhan, alwida alwida
<<MINI>>
alwida alwida ae behen alwida..(3)
